raw_annotations.proposed_function: The GAR region contributes to DNA binding of MRE11.
raw_annotations.evidence: These results suggest that the regions encompassing the GAR motif and arginine methylation both contribute to MRE11 DNA binding (Fig. 6D).

raw_annotations.proposed_function: The GAR region mediates interaction/multimerization of MRE11 with NBS1.
raw_annotations.evidence: MRE11- GAR multimerized (see Fig. S1A in the supplemental material) and interacted with NBS1 (see Fig. S1B in the supplemental material), suggesting that it was folded properly.
